title: arachniodes tonkinensis
intro: Arachniodes tonkinensis, commonly known as Tonkin fern, is a species of fern native to Southeast Asia. Tonkin fern is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tonkin fern include its ability to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Tonkin fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
